non_goals: Not a proof that semi-simplicial types are undefinable in HoTT, and not an inconsistency.
The identification of Coh3 with other formulations of the second coherence (indexed SST<=4, Reedy fibrant diagrams) is not machine-proved, and Coh3 on flat is not shown equivalent to Deg3 in general.
